data.title: 阿尔法 · 玻璃花房的白玫瑰相赠
data.description: 阳光和煦的欧式温室玻璃花房内，绿意葱郁。阿尔法身穿优雅的纯白礼裙，素手轻剪下一支盛放的白玫瑰递上前，金发在光束中宛若流金，眼神深情而庄重。
data.location: lush botanical conservatory glasshouse filled with blooming white roses and ferns
data.action: holding a freshly cut white rose by the stem, offering the flower forward, graceful posture, gentle fond expression, golden curls catching light shafts
data.lighting: radiant dappled sunlight streaming through curved glasshouse panels and leafy canopy
data.mood: aristocratic elegance, pure romantic dedication, breathtaking botanical beauty
data.promptProse: Inside a sunlit glass conservatory surrounded by blooming white roses, Alpha gracefully extends a single white blossom forward, her eyes shimmering with tender devotion.
data.animaCaption: Offering a freshly picked white rose in the sunlit glasshouse, she smiles with graceful devotion.
